A '''traveling air rodeo''' that featured [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]] was owned at one point by a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Unidentified air rodeo owner|owner]]. An [[Unidentified animal rights group|animal rights group]] kidnapped the woman who owned the rodeo, planning to starve her for a [[Standard week/Legends|week]]. They did this to show her how the large, winged thrantas felt when they nearly starved during the transportation process due to the lack of [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] necessary for photosynthesis.<ref name="Rodeo" />
{{RPGseed}}
After the rodeo's owner was captured, some well known individuals in area were asked to help find the owner.<ref name="Rodeo" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The traveling air rodeo first appeared as part of an adventure idea in ''[[Rodeo Thranta]]'', an article written by [[Jeff Quick]] as part of the ''[[Creature Feature]]'' series of articles for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Wizards.com|website]]. The article was released on [[December]] [[December 12|12]], [[2002]], with the adventure ideas being usable by gamemasters at any time after thrantas were first used in air rodeos, which happened before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the thrantas [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Rodeo" />
